headline: matu997 takes the last ARC-2 gold place as the line rises to 66.53

sections.text: matu997 moved from 18th to 16th at 66.53, gaining 2.22, and now holds the last of the 16 gold places.
The gold line itself rose 0.97 in the past day to 66.53. NguyenThanhNhan, 17th at 65.97, is 0.56 short and is the first team outside gold.

sources.title: ARC-AGI-2 public leaderboard: saved board and the past day's changes
